title: Big Man Workout
description: A 35-minute post and paint session: footwork, seals, hooks, face-up moves, pick-and-roll finishing, and rebounding toughness.

items.name: Mikan and reverse Mikan
items.detail: 2 minutes standard, 2 minutes reverse. Ball never touches the floor; use the glass.

items.name: Drop-step series
items.detail: Catch on the block, drop-step baseline and middle: 5 makes each side, finishing strong off two feet.

items.name: Jump-hook series
items.detail: Baby hooks over an imaginary defender: 5 makes each hand, each side. High release, soft touch.

items.name: Up-and-under counters
items.detail: Shot-fake, step-through finishes: 5 makes each side. Sell the fake with your eyes and shoulders.

items.name: Face-up moves
items.detail: Catch at the elbow, face up: jab-and-go drives and jab-and-shoot, 5 makes each. Read the defender's feet.

items.name: Pick-and-roll finishing
items.detail: Sprint to screen a chair, roll hard to the rim, catch and finish: short rolls, lobs, and seals. 10 reps.

items.name: Rebounding battle
items.detail: Toss the ball off the glass, box out an imaginary man, pursue and chin it. 20 aggressive rebounds.

items.name: Free-throw finish
items.detail: Bigs shoot free throws too: 10 with your routine. 7+ makes is the standard.

tips: Every post move starts with the seal — no seal, no catch, no move.
Finish off two feet through contact; one-foot floaters are for guards.
Keep the ball high on every catch — bringing it down invites strips.
Rebounding is a mindset drill: attack the glass like every miss is yours.
